data_flow: The README.md section will trace the end-to-end Phase 4 planner loop flow as built: 1. Scope & goal capture (OPEN -> SCOPED): caller posts T1 scope.captured to POST /rooms/:roomId/events with scope ({ repository, baseSha, paths }) and goal; prepareFounderGoal hashes goal into a founder_goal evidence ref and PostgresLedgerStore commits T1. 2. Opening a round (SCOPED -> PLANNING or PLANNING retry/revision): triggered via POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round, PlannerLoop.openFirstRound derives G2 facts and atomically appends T2 task.dispatched.planner and the command's journaled row (cmd_planner_<32 hex>) under the room lock and journal append lock; on revision (after T4) or a not_sent retry within MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS (3), openNextAttempt journals the next command ID. 3. Outbound Gateway poll, attestation & execution: the assigned Gateway polls POST /gateway/planner/poll; GatewayPlannerChannel issues an attest directive, journals identity_bound once the Gateway confirms its bound identity, and issues an execute directive carrying repository, baseSha, scopePaths, and the recovered founder_goal text. GatewayPlannerWorker records starting on disk before calling AgyPlannerExecutor.start, which verifies binary hash and clean process state, checks out baseSha read-only, spawns agy under plannerUser in plan/sandbox mode, waits for the stream-json init event (gemini-4-argon-high) before sending the prompt, and reports running (with initModel and conversationId) and then finished (with the raw PlanDoc text) to POST /gateway/planner/report. 4. Plan judgment & atomic submission (PLANNING -> PLAN_REVIEW): executeRound journals dispatched (recording init_model and provider_conversation_id), awaits the plan, runs judgeRoundPlan (PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1, readyForDecision, repository/base_sha match, and scope_paths inside captured scope), and in submitRoundPlan atomically writes T3 plan.submitted, PlanStore.recordPlan in public.build_room_plans, and the journal completed row (checked by CompletionAuthorizationResolver). 5. Founder review & adjudication (PLAN_REVIEW -> PLAN_APPROVED | PLANNING | CANCELLED): the Founder reads the stored plan via GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan (and during a counted run the harness also writes plan-<planHash>.json locally) and posts plan.approved (T5), plan.revision_requested (T4 with feedback), or founder.cancel (T22) to POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision, which re-judges the stored plan and atomically commits both the room transition and the bound journal decision row (or marks an in-flight command unresolved with unconfirmed-cancel on T22).
trust_and_security_boundaries: The README.md update will document the implemented trust boundaries without weakening any control: 1. Token separation: CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN (room/plan read and occupancy), PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN (Founder plan-decision route), and PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN (counted-run planner-round and journal routes, inert when PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN is unset) are strictly separated. 2. Ledger & journal authority: GOVERNED_PATH_EVENTS cannot be posted to POST /rooms/:roomId/events; server-derived transition facts (rolesAssigned, reviewerIsNotBuilder, gatewayOnline, planDocSchemaValid, planHash, founderApprovalRecorded, revisionFeedbackAttached, runningTasksCancelled, unconfirmedCancelRecorded) are computed on the server, never accepted from request bodies; JournalStore requires database user br_app_runtime and CompletionAuthorizationResolver coverage before any completed row commits. 3. Gateway & executor isolation: the control plane never dials inbound to a Gateway; Gateway requests are Ed25519-signed and sequence-checked; AgyPlannerExecutor runs only on Linux Gateway 1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a under dedicated OS account BUILDROOM_PLANNER_USER in a read-only git checkout with --mode plan --sandbox, verifies the root-owned binary SHA-256 before every launch, gates prompt delivery on the stream-json init model check, and halts via planner-halted.json on any process or cleanup anomaly. 4. Secret & log hygiene: prepareFounderGoal, PlanStore.recordPlan, and planDecisionRouter scan inputs with containsCredentialMaterial; logPlanRefused logs only structural refusal codes and masks undeclared property names as <undeclared key> without logging plan text.
